title: Harborline Reseller Tiers on Professional Email Reactivation Renewals
content:
Reseller programme schedule. On a Professional Email reactivation renewal, the account-tier rate is the email discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the tier recorded on the account on the charge date.

| Subscription and tier recorded on the account on the charge date | Account-tier rate |
|---|---|
| Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Platinum | the Platinum email discount percentage |
| Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Gold | the Gold email discount percentage |
| Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Silver | the Silver email discount percentage |
| Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Bronze | the Bronze email discount percentage |
| any Microsoft 365 subscription, whatever the tier | none |
| any other account | none |

**How the rate acts.** The account-tier rate reduces the renewal component of a reactivation renewal once, before it is rounded; no other percentage is added to it or compounded with it, and it never reduces a fee or a credit.

Examples (hypothetical accounts): a Harborline Reseller Silver account reactivating a suspended Harborline Mail Pro subscription takes the Silver email discount percentage on the renewal component; a Harborline Reseller Platinum account reactivating a Microsoft 365 Business Standard subscription takes no account-tier rate.
